tow_rope.name: Tow rope
tow_rope.desc: Six metres of braided nylon with a hook spliced in each end. It stretches and it takes a jerk, until it doesn't.

tow_chain.name: Tow chain
tow_chain.desc: Five metres of grade chain with a grab hook. Heavy, no give at all, and it will drag a truck.

plate.name: BOILER PLATE
plate.desc: Quarter-inch boiler steel cut from a dead refinery. The honest choice: stops a burst a slab and weighs like sin.

sheet.name: SHEET STEEL
sheet.desc: Road signs and fridge doors hammered flat. Light, cheap, and gone in a long burst.

ablative.name: ABLATIVE PACK
ablative.desc: Ceramic tiles in fibre bags. It burns away so the steel under it does not. Laughs at flame.

spaced.name: SPACED PLATE
spaced.desc: Two skins with a hand-span of air between. A rocket spends itself on the first one.

ram.name: RAM PLATE
ram.desc: A wedge of grader blade. You stop caring what you hit.

plow.name: COWCATCHER
plow.desc: A railroad grille welded to the frame. The dead go under and to the side, not through the glass.

spikes.name: SPIKE STRIP
spikes.desc: Rebar points sharpened on a wheel. Nobody hangs onto this side for long.

mg1.name: MACHINE GUN
mg1.desc: One belt-fed gun on a welded cradle. Cheap, reliable, chews through tyres.

mg.name: TWIN MG
mg.desc: Two guns on one trigger, alternating. The standard nose of anything that wants to live on the interstate.

hmg.name: HEAVY MACHINE GUN
hmg.desc: A .50 on a welded ring. Every round a hammer; the car shudders under it.

autocannon.name: AUTOCANNON
autocannon.desc: A slow, heavy thump that dents plate a slab at a time. Every shot rocks the car.

rockets.name: ROCKET POD
rockets.desc: Six tubes, dumb-fire. Point the car and pray. A hit opens a face like a tin.

seeker.name: SEEKER POD
seeker.desc: Four rockets with a dish in the nose. Hold on a car for a second and they follow it. Flares fool them.

heavyrocket.name: HEAVY ROCKET
heavyrocket.desc: One fat tube on the hood. One shot, one car. Reload at a garage or carry the round yourself.

flamer.name: FLAMETHROWER
flamer.desc: A pump, a tank of jellied fuel and a pilot light. Ugly at close range, and the dead burn.

laser.name: LASER
laser.desc: Pre-war. A lens the size of a fist and a hum you feel in your teeth. Never runs dry while the power holds.

rail.name: RAIL GUN
rail.desc: Pre-war. It drinks the whole battery, sings for a second and a half, then puts a slug through two cars and whoever stands behind them.

harpoon.name: HARPOON GUN
harpoon.desc: A whaling gun on a cable drum. Bite a car and tow it; fire again and yank it off its wheels.

grapple.name: GRAPPLING HOOK
grapple.desc: A four-prong hook on three car lengths of chain. One throw in three it bites; then you own that car until the chain gives.

grapple_rig.name: RIGGED GRAPPLE
grapple_rig.desc: The same hook on a winch drum and six car lengths of chain. Still bites one throw in three, from twice as far.

minedrop.name: MINE DROPPER
minedrop.desc: A chute of pressure mines. Arms a second after it lands; the next set of wheels over it goes up.

oil.name: OIL SPRAYER
oil.desc: A drum of waste oil and a nozzle under the bumper. Whoever is on your tail spins.

caltrops.name: CALTROP DROPPER
caltrops.desc: Welded jacks by the bucket. Somebody behind you is changing a tyre.

smoke.name: SMOKE LAYER
smoke.desc: A smudge pot on a blower. Nothing behind you can see you, or the road.

flares.name: FLARE DISPENSER
flares.desc: Magnesium flares thrown high. A seeker or a drone chasing your heat chases them instead.

paint.name: PAINT SPRAYER
paint.desc: House paint and a compressor. A windshield behind you goes white and the driver goes wild.

emp.name: EMP PROJECTOR
emp.desc: Pre-war. A coil the length of your arm. Every engine in front of you dies for a few long seconds.

battery.name: BATTERY BANK
battery.desc: Six truck batteries in a crate. Holds a charge for the energy guns; the alternator fills it.

powerplant.name: POWER PLANT
powerplant.desc: Pre-war. A sealed cell that runs warm and never stops. What the rail gun was built to drink from.

extinguisher.name: FIRE SUPPRESSION
extinguisher.desc: Two bottles and a ring of nozzles under the hood. Puts out a burning car twice.

nowindshield.name: PULL THE WINDSHIELD
nowindshield.desc: Out comes the glass, in goes a wire screen. Now you can shoot over the hood, and so can they.

runflat.name: RUN-FLAT TYRES
runflat.desc: Inserts in the rims. A blown tyre still rolls, badly, instead of dragging you into the ditch.

solidtyres.name: PUNCTURE-PROOF TYRES
solidtyres.desc: Solid rubber, no air to lose. Caltrops and rounds do nothing. The ride shakes your fillings out.

tread_road.name: ROAD TYRES
tread_road.desc: Smooth highway rubber. Glued to the blacktop, a skating rink the moment you leave it.

tread_offroad.name: OFF-ROAD TYRES
tread_offroad.desc: Knobbly lugs that dig into sand and mud. On the highway they hum and wander.

tread_allterrain.name: ON/OFF-ROAD TYRES
tread_allterrain.desc: Half and half. Better than what came on the car everywhere, best nowhere.

monster.name: MONSTER TYRES
monster.desc: Tractor tyres on a lift kit. Wades rivers, climbs over cars, corners like a wardrobe.

nitrous.name: NITROUS
nitrous.desc: A bottle and a button. Boost (Shift) at speed and the car jumps like it was kicked.

turbo.name: TURBOCHARGER
turbo.desc: A scavenged turbo plumbed in with exhaust tube and hope. More shove everywhere.

bumpers.name: REINFORCED BUMPERS
bumpers.desc: I-beam bumpers front and back. A shunt costs the other car more than you.

fueltank.name: EXTRA FUEL TANK
fueltank.desc: Forty more litres in the boot. The desert is wide.

cargorack.name: CARGO RACK
cargorack.desc: A roof cage and straps. More room in the trunk for what you find.

gunports.name: GUN PORTS
gunports.desc: Slots cut in the doors with sliding covers. Your passengers shoot without losing the glass.

targeting.name: TARGETING COMPUTER
targeting.desc: A pre-war fire-control box wired to the triggers. Tightens every gun and locks the seekers faster.

hubspikes.name: HUB SPIKES
hubspikes.desc: Sharpened steel cones welded to the hubs, sticking out the side. Rub a car alongside and its tyres go to ribbons, its doors and your shins with them.

spotlight.name: ROOF SPOTLIGHT
spotlight.desc: A searchlight off a dead patrol boat, bolted to the roof bars. It turns night into a stage, and you are on it.

winch.name: HARPOON WINCH
winch.desc: A tow drum geared down off a wrecker. Bite a door and drive away: the door comes with you. Gates too.

dronebay.name: DRONE BAY
dronebay.desc: A roof cradle with a charger and a latch. Its outrider flies ahead of you on its own and marks what waits up the road (the \ key).

radar.name: RADAR DETECTOR
radar.desc: A dash box that screams when something locks onto you, or an armed car closes within a long block.

belt_mg.name: MG belt
belt_mg.desc: A hundred linked rounds in a steel can. Feeds either hood gun.

belt_50.name: .50 belt
belt_50.desc: Fifty linked .50 rounds in a can you need both hands for. Feeds the heavy gun.

ac_shells.name: Autocannon shells
ac_shells.desc: Twenty fat shells in a crate with rope handles.

rocket.name: Rocket
rocket.desc: A tube with fins and a bad attitude. Fits the pods.

heavy_rocket.name: Heavy rocket
heavy_rocket.desc: One round for the big tube. Carry it like it is asleep.

napalm.name: Napalm can
napalm.desc: Jellied fuel. It sticks, and it keeps burning.

rail_slug.name: Rail slugs
rail_slug.desc: Two pre-war tungsten slugs in foam. Nobody makes these any more.

car_mine.name: Car mine
car_mine.desc: A pressure plate on a cake tin of explosive. Do not step on it either.

oil_drum.name: Waste oil
oil_drum.desc: Black sludge drained from a hundred dead engines. Two slicks.

smoke_can.name: Smudge oil
smoke_can.desc: Oil cut with tar for the smoke layer. Two clouds.

flare_pack.name: Flare pack
flare_pack.desc: Three magnesium flares and a striker.

paint_can.name: Paint drum
paint_can.desc: White house paint, thinned for the sprayer.

nitrous_bottle.name: Nitrous bottle
nitrous_bottle.desc: A blue bottle that hisses. One burst.

suppressant.name: Suppressant bottle
suppressant.desc: A charge for the car's fire system.

dustbowl.name: THE DUST BOWL
dustbowl.desc: A dried-out reservoir ringed with tyres. Friday nights, last car moving keeps the pot.

loopline.name: LOOPLINE SPEEDWAY
loopline.desc: An old county oval, the grandstand half burnt. The promoter lends junkers to anybody with nerve.
